text:
CONNECTOR::remap
Description
This command sets client/server IP/Port from connector.
Syntax
CONNECTOR
::
remap
<
client_addr
|
server_addr
>
<
ip_addr
>
CONNECTOR
::
remap
<
client_port
|
server_port
>
<
port
>
Examples
when
CONNECTOR_OPEN
{
if
{([
CONNECTOR
::
profile
]
eq
"/Common/connector_profile_1"
)}
{
CONNECTOR
::
remap
client_addr
10.10
.10.2
log
local0.
"Remap client IP address from connector to 10.10.10.2"
CONNECTOR
::
remap
client_port
333
log
local0.
"Remap client port from connector to 333"
CONNECTOR
::
remap
server_addr
20.20
.20.2
log
local0.
"Remap server IP address from connector to 20.20.20.2"
CONNECTOR
::
remap
server_port
999
log
local0.
"Remap server port from connector to 999"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANY
